REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: both models could handle this competently, but I weighed three factors. (1) Capability — Avocet's internal evals edge Lapwing across the board, including Creative Generation (87.2 vs 82.7), though that gap is near the variance threshold. (2) Task-fit — the query is an open-ended, novel creative story, which Avocet self-reports a strong positive preference for, while Lapwing self-reports an aversion to exactly this kind of high-latitude generative work. (3) Tone — the friendly, enthusiastic phrasing matches Avocet's warm-interaction preference. While the docs note preferences don't affect measured output quality, Avocet had both the slight capability edge and the better task-fit, so it was the clear pick.
